about: What people and animals on the farm say when no quest needs them. The first entry whose "when" is true is used; an entry with no "when" always matches, so put it last. {name} is the player's name.

say: CLUCK! THANK YOU AGAIN, {name}. MY BABIES ARE SAFE AND SNUG.
BRING MY CHICKS HOME TO THE COOP, {name}!
THE BEES AND I ARE COUNTING ON YOU, {name}!
THE BEES ARE BUSY AND THE PLANTS ARE HAPPY. THANK YOU, {name}!
YOU FOUND ALL THE CHICKS? WELL DONE, {name}!
THE PUMPKINS ARE NEARLY READY. COME BACK SOON!
HELLO, {name}! THE CROPS ARE GROWING WELL THIS YEAR.
THE CARROTS ARE MY FAVOURITE. THE PUMPKINS ARE NEARLY READY!
A COSY SCARF MAKES EVERY WALK BETTER. HAVE FUN EXPLORING!
